# SuperSnake

> SuperSnake is a free browser snake game at https://supersnake.iamraj.dev/. There is no grid and no fixed speed: the snake's head goes exactly where the player points. It works on computers, phones and tablets with nothing to install and no sign-up. Made by Raj Patel under the Superverse brand (https://iamraj.dev/superverse/).

## How it plays

- Eat the coloured dots: each one is worth one point and adds one segment to the tail, in the dot's colour.
- The game ends when the head touches an edge of the board or the snake's own body, or when the clock runs out.
- Controls: mouse or touchpad (the head follows the pointer), arrow keys or W/A/S/D, and an on-screen joystick on touch screens (a small push moves slowly, a full push fast, letting go stops the snake). Esc or the End button ends a game early.
- Modes: Infinite (no clock), 15 seconds, 30 seconds and 60 seconds. Each mode keeps its own best score, saved in the browser on that device.
- Optional background music (four tracks) with separate music and sound effect volume.
